formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (Np Nl : ℕ) (I : Fin Np → Fin Nl → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ p p' : Fin Np, ∀ l l' : Fin Nl, p ≠ p' → l ≠ l' → ¬ (I p l ∧ I p l' ∧ I p' l ∧ I p' l')) → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (Np + Nl) C → (∀ z : Fin (Np + Nl) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (Np + Nl) C z = decide (∃ p : Fin Np, ∃ l : Fin Nl, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd Nl p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd Np l) = true)) → ∃ (D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (P L : Finset ℕ), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (Np + Nl) D ∧ (∀ y : Fin (Np + Nl) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (Np + Nl) D y = decide (∃ p : Fin Np, ∃ l : Fin Nl, I p l ∧ y (Fin.castAdd Nl p) = true ∧ y (Fin.natAdd Np l) = true)) ∧ D.size ≤ C.size ∧ (∀ w ∈ P, w < Np ∨ ∃ i < D.gates.length, w = Np + Nl + i ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ ∀ u ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D i).inputs, u ∈ P) ∧ (∀ w ∈ L, (Np ≤ w ∧ w < Np + Nl) ∨ ∃ i < D.gates.length, w = Np + Nl + i ∧ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧ ∀ u ∈ (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D i).inputs, u ∈ L) ∧ ∀ i < D.gates.length, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → ∃ a b : ℕ, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D i).inputs = [a, b] ∧ ((a ∈ P ∧ b ∈ L) ∨ (a ∈ L ∧ b ∈ P)))
plain_statement: It is false that: P points, L lines, any incidence in which no two points share two lines; inputs the points then the lines. For every circuit C of AND/OR gates only, each reading exactly two earlier wires, no constants, true exactly when some incident point and line are both on, there is a circuit D of the same kind computing the same function with at most as many gates, in two levels: each AND gate reads one point-side wire (a point input or an OR of point-side wires) and one line-side wire (likewise with lines); all other gates are ORs.
